descriptions.en: Drop a single APK or APKM file onto the NotchAny notch to install it on a connected Android device. APKM split bundles are extracted and installed with `adb install-multiple`; single APKs use `adb install -r` so existing apps can be replaced. The action reads the base APK manifest to detect `debuggable` and `testOnly`; debug or test packages require confirmation before `-t` is used. When multiple eligible devices are connected, a target picker appears. Offline and unauthorized devices are excluded. Requires `adb` from Android Platform Tools.
descriptions.zh-Hans: 把单个 APK 或 APKM 文件拖入 NotchAny 刘海，即可安装到已连接的 Android 设备。APKM 分包会自动解包并通过 `adb install-multiple` 安装；单个 APK 使用 `adb install -r`，支持覆盖安装。动作会读取 base APK 的 Manifest，识别 `debuggable` 和 `testOnly`；遇到调试或测试包时先请求确认，再追加 `-t`。连接多台可用设备时会显示目标选择框，并过滤 offline 或 unauthorized 设备。依赖 Android Platform Tools 中的 `adb`。

summaries.en: Drop an APK or APKM, choose an Android device, and install it through ADB.
summaries.zh-Hans: 拖入 APK 或 APKM，选择 Android 设备并自动完成 ADB 安装。
